question: What is the function of Joint Inspection Teams (JIT) under JMC No. 2021-01 in commercial business permitting?
answer: The Joint Inspection Teams (JIT) under JMC No. 2021-01 serve the function of conducting inspections of an applicant's office/premises, in relation to an application for a new business permit or renewal. This is to limit the face-to-face interaction between the applicant and LGU officials, as stated in Section 9.1.2 of JMC No. 01 Series of 2021 [S1]. Additionally, these teams are also formed to address the lack of personnel of inspection departments and agencies compared to the number of establishments, as mentioned in Section 9.1.4 of the same JMC [S3].

ground_truth: Section 9.1.2 of JMC 2021-01 mandates the organization of Joint Inspection Teams (JIT) combining LGU inspectors and BFP personnel to conduct joint physical inspections, limiting face-to-face contact and eliminating redundant multiple visits.
